`*.synthetic.*` are explicitly synthetic fixtures for edge cases. `profile.live.html` is a sanitized, reduced real Koffi Kouao response captured on 2026-09-06; its ID and URL are in the accompanying metadata. `performance.live.json` contains normalized public rows from the same successful probe (mapped back to the endpoint's field names). Future probes save the original public statistics JSON and minimal semantic HTML. No cookies, session headers, scripts, forms or tracking payloads are stored. Normal tests use disk fixtures and mocked fetch, never the live site.
